notes: Pixel Games v1: the classic block-head fighters with matching, sweat-shiny heads and better ears, new fight-night lighting in the octagon and glowing lamp-lit, neon streets, and everything that plays the way it should — the Black Flash only when a finisher lands on the head, the stronger heavy-hit impact frame, the Turf Wars crown reward, turning to face someone before punching, natural spins and kicks, and a referee who stays on his feet.
